epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease unauthorized material modifications from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: Restrict material uploads and modifications on /api/materials endpoints to authenticated users

slices.title: Patch /api/materials endpoints for write access control
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to restrict material uploads and modifications to authenticated users, so that unauthorized actors cannot corrupt or delete epidemiological records
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated request
When attempting to POST, PUT, or DELETE to /api/materials
Then the server responds with 401 Unauthorized
Given an authenticated but unauthorized request
When attempting to POST, PUT, or DELETE to /api/materials
Then the server responds with 403 Forbidden
Given these security constraints
When tests are written
Then they explicitly verify the 401 Unauthorized and 403 Forbidden scenarios in *Test.java files
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease unauthorized write success rate from 100% to 0%
